My dear [Mrs Elgie](/person/475)
I have a stupid cold in my head.

If it gets fine, I will come down at 2, if I see [Miss Davies](/person/408) go by in the fly, but I thought she was not coming in rain.[^1] If she does come, and the rain goes on I am afraid I must ask her to look in on me on her way, I should not mind the damp or this slight cold, only it makes [G](/person/1462) so unhappy for me to go out
your affec
CMY


[^1]: Perhaps Miss Davies who was Diocesan Secretary of the Girls’ Friendly Society in 1878.
